notes.title: Important update of the demo version of the game
notes.notes:
Attention, attention, attention! Gertruder! Achtung! 

At Count Dracula's behest, our tame -- and undead -- gnomes have risen from their little coffins and conjured up a new demo version of After Shadows. We don't have enough pony skins to describe all the changes (we don't use paper, preferring all natural and beautiful), so we'll make only theses remarks:

* The demo version fully supports the controller. You no longer have to break your fingers on the keyboard, trying to hit the right button. 

* The dark monster has become more charismatic and dangerous, like Hannibal Lecter. He's not so easy to get away from anymore. Yum, yum, yum...

* Improved HUD interface. Now you know exactly where to look and what to do.

* Completely fixed the operation of the ropes. No more swinging like a fool and jumping past.

* Fixed bugs in training. From now on, you won't accidentally sell your soul to Satan!

*Visual is now as beautiful as the Mona Lisa. Only without Mona. And the Lisa. And it has nothing to do with anything!

* And lots of other things.

Turn on the demo and enjoy the innovations. Otherwise, our tame, undead gnomes will be put to rest forever in the nearest tree!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40829295/441d4fdea93461e32b700ce00ca2f7dc52e520d1.png[/img]

Friends, we have two good news!

[b]First news[/b]: After Shadows will take part in the Steam Fall Next Fest along with other game demos.

notes.title: Steady march to release
notes.notes:
Well, to make a long story short, our narrative is steadily moving towards release. Do you expect this? 

We do. We work hard, losing our nerves and spending the time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40829295/21aec781bd00f09c4e2a4a45f55b9ff8efe3e003.jpg[/img]

Meanwhile the full game version is being completed and finished, we strongly recommend to try out the already existing and available demo: a link is in the profile header.

And don't forget to add the game to the wishlist — this is really important.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40829295/cca322e7463cc2ce8444d59f5e79b2ad4aabc813.jpg[/img]

Special thanks and plus fifty points to karma to those who share our publications in their accounts, recommend us on YouTube and write a variety of pleasant things in the comments and direct - your contribution to our efficiency and psychological stability is invaluable. Thank you.

So, you should keep up the good work, guys: you play, comment, add to the wishlist and wait for the release!

notes.title: Indie Cup S'21 nominations
notes.notes:
[h1]Indie Cup[/h1]

Well, while we are going deeper and deeper into the hopeless darkness of the mysterious Fortress, the After Shadows' popularitg is steadily growing. You can't imagine, but a few weeks ago we took part in the big indie game contest, the Indie Cup!
We don't mean to be flirtatious, but we didn't expect any definite results from this contest, and were doing it more for sport than by practical reasons. But on August 12, the organizers published shortlists, and can't you imagine, but we have won three nominations!
So, ladies and gentlemen, After Shadows is officially among the best in the nominations:

[h3]- Streamers’ Choice;[/h3]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40829295/65891afa9b3a1325932fd288ac771c8cc0b347e2.jpg[/img]
[h3]- Best Art;[/h3]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40829295/d832d269f582868b30ecbc552b3191603d978d7e.jpg[/img]
[h3]- Best Unity Game.[/h3]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40829295/301779630b3a24cedce3bb7272cd55e4d574c42c.jpg[/img]

Congratulations to our team: this isn't a victory yet, but it's already a recognition. Well done!

notes.title: More info on the game
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40829295/710d00f9ac749ce3bb8616267677f11b641cf687.png[/img]

[h1][b]Mechanics [/b][/h1]

So, we hope you have already played the After Shadows' demo (again, we remind you that the demo does not yet have controller support; in the release it will, of course). If you have done this, discuss your experience in the comments.

There are several points that are important to clarify.

After Shadows is a metroidvania. In the best traditions of metroidvania the game consists of one very large and complicated location. The demo shows us about one quarter of this location and, believe me, this is the easiest part of it.

The game point is in the passage through this large and complicated location. Even if you complete the game, charge all the crystals, get to the Tree and receive a gift from it, with a new game you will find yourself at the same location. Your task is to explore it properly, learn how to dodge Dark Monster, foresee traps and find the best way.

The gifts from the Tree are artifacts that make your progress easy. If you fail and die, you will receive a curse that will make your life harder at the next replay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40829295/a9622c76a19fae19a8a4b7d0a723119f369adfb7.png[/img]

The replay cycle is not infinite. The finale, which depends on how successful your attempts were, will come, sooner or later. At the very best the Tree will give you the cure for Ana and Lipsy's mother.
Perhaps this will happen after the first successful play, but don't count on that too much — the probability is so small that if this happens, we earnestly advise you to buy a lottery ticket on the same day — such luck shouldn't be missed.

In general, there will be four alternative game endings. We won't tell about them, it's an intrigue. It depends only on you, your memory, spatial reasoning, and ingenuity, how much time it will take to explore the location completely.

The location is not large — it's huge! A full exploration of all its corridors, cubbyholes, portals and traps can take several dozen of hours and hundreds of replays. You can always get to any game point at least in two ways, find them all and choose the best one for yourself.

You will be able to play from the start to the Tree without mistakes for a few minutes, sooner or late, but, believe me, you'll have to try very hard, exploring, making mistakes, dying and reborning in new replays.
